application_review: PROGRESS. Baseline proof hashes are preserved.
The theorem instantiates actual prediction modulus P, quotient factors P/M and R/P, original interval width R, and original harmonic integerMass.
Positive quotient factors and nonempty short direction sets are derived from the original master conditions. Existential positivity witnesses are proved conclusions, not new assumptions.
The retained-cell index contains exactly aligned cells with admissible residues. Its weights are their actual harmonic masses divided by actual retained mass.
The finite full-window bound and the vanishing original remainder give a single eventual threshold uniform in same-pool x and all unit-bounded real tests.
The actual integer shift is P times the signed short difference sum. P is the positive absolute prediction modulus; equivalence with a signed-modulus formulation is not claimed here.
One new theorem is individually kernel audited. This theorem supplies a quantitative Gowers bound, not the missing Bessel or inverse theorem and not StrongConjecture.
